bio.heading: Who is Sal?
description: Back in 2016, I decided to try my hand at creating custom Tumblr themes and tumbled head first into the rabbit hole of coding and web development.

Fast forward to today, I've built products for companies and businesses around the world, ranging from marketing websites, startups, to enterprise apps with focus on fast, elegant and user friendly experiences.
When I'm not coding, I'm regularly playing football, both online and in real life, practicing boxing and making music.

experience.title: Partner
experience.description: Wife's business. Responsible for technology delivery across the custom booking system, marketing website, and operational web application.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
experience.description: Stack: TypeScript, React, Java Spring Boot / WebFlux, ELK, LLMs, Cimulate AI. Played a key role in migrating Loblaws' e-commerce search to Cimulate APIs in under two months, lifting query engine performance and result relevance across PCX, SDM, and LCL. Built and operated scalable Java backend services on Google Cloud Platform supporting high-traffic production search workloads. Hardened observability and incident response by integrating and tuning the ELK Stack, and used LLMs to analyze search logs and reduce null-result queries by sharpening query understanding.

experience.title: Co-founder
experience.description: Building the world's best GTM playbook engine — a simple yet powerful way for GTM teams to build, enrich, and execute playbooks without needing a full-time GTM engineer or complex workflows.

experience.title: AI Presenter
experience.description: Speaking at community Meetups on AI and full-stack engineering — practical patterns for building production-grade LLM-powered features.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
experience.company: Cooperators — Amy Wang Insurance & Investment Inc.
experience.description: Stack: Java Spring Boot / WebFlux, MSSQL, LLMs. Developed Spring Boot microservices that migrated large policy datasets from PolicyCenter into SIS with minimal disruption to downstream consumers, piloted a proof-of-concept for Bordereau storage by integrating directly with the PolicyCenter service, and stewarded 200+ business rules governing data flows between PolicyCenter and SIS across multiple policy and transaction types. Designed and shipped an insurance-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation chatbot that answered coverage and claims questions over vector-indexed policy documents, underwriting guidelines, and client-specific declarations — reducing advisor workload and lifting response accuracy.

experience.title: Lead Full Stack Developer
experience.description: Stack: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Java Spring Boot / WebFlux, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, Llama, Mistral. Demo: dev.prividox.com. Led development on PriviDox, Oproma's file management system — delivering robust production code on TypeScript / React / Next.js up front and Java Spring Boot / WebFlux on the backend. Reshaped the PriviDox and MiCore interfaces around intuitive UX, optimized the Docker / AWS infrastructure for scalability, and integrated Llama and Mistral models to extend product capabilities.

experience.title: Lead Full Stack Developer

experience.title: Full Stack Development Contractor
experience.description: At Research Capital Corporation, key initiatives were led to enhance operational efficiency and data analytics. A sophisticated trade blotter system was developed for precise tracking of electricity trades, alongside the re-architecture of the ML model training pipeline using Python, significantly improving predictive accuracy and efficiency. The reworking of metrics collection using Prefect streamlined data accuracy and efficiency. The establishment of a Kubernetes environment with AWS EKS facilitated the deployment of diverse ML pipelines, ensuring scalability and robust operations. Furthermore, the automation of code deployment through a CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions, and the integration of Grafana for advanced data visualization and reporting, provided critical insights for decision-making. These contributions were pivotal in driving technological advancement and operational excellence at the company.

experience.title: Full Stack Development Contractor
experience.description: Developed a client-facing mobile app using React Native and TypeScript to facilitate last-mile transportation logistics for company employees, saving hundreds of labour-hours previously spent on manual data collection. The backend, powered by GCP's Firebase and the Samsara ecosystem, was swiftly prototyped to enable scalable operations, while an upgraded landing page was crafted using React and Gatsby to enhance business appeal to potential clients.

experience.title: Backend Development Contractor
experience.description: Automated deployment processes for easier deployment to production, which also optimized AWS costs during high-traffic hours. Frontend files were fine-tuned for enhanced client experience, and a migration from Magento's query engine extension to Algolia was executed to enhance querying capabilities.

experience.title: Software Developer Co-op

Furthermore, creating applications with C# and .NET Core, and incorporating RPA bots with client systems via Web API 2.0. Enhanced user interfaces with WPF, improving RPA management tools through intuitive design and Redis Caching for performance.
